records.text: The Times of Israel reported that Israel’s foreign ministry hired an American firm for an influence campaign of up to $4.1 million aimed at Christians in the western United States.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Here's a Times of Israel article about that. This was published in October, and it says Israel to spend up to $4.1 million on a Christian PR campaign in the West. ... It says the foreign ministry has hired another American firm to run influence operations in the United States with plans to spend as much as $4.1 million on a marketing campaign aimed at Christians across the western part of the country.

verification.notes: The cited Times of Israel article says the Foreign Ministry hired an American firm and planned to spend up to $4.1 million on marketing aimed at Christians across the western United States. The transcript paraphrase is accurate.

sources.title: Israel to spend up to $4.1M to bolster support among Christians in western US
sources.relevance: Directly verifies the cited article and its reported amount, contractor, audience, and region.

records.text: The Times of Israel reported that Johnnie Moore was appointed executive chairman of the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation after CEO Jake Wood quit and Boston Consulting Group abandoned the project.
records.speaker: The Times of Israel

appearances.snippet: Check out this headline, Times of Israel. Gaza Humanitarian Foundation taps U.S. evangelical leader Johnny Moore as the new chairman. ... It tells us that he was appointed as the new executive chairman of the Gaza Humanitarian Foundation, which is the U.S. and Israel-backed organization providing aid to Gazans. ... Its previous CEO, Jake Wood, quit last week and the Boston Consulting Group abandoned the project today.

verification.notes: The Times of Israel reported that GHF appointed Johnnie Moore executive chairman after Jake Wood resigned, and described the change as following Boston Consulting Group’s withdrawal from the project.

sources.title: Gaza Humanitarian Foundation taps Johnnie Moore as new chairman
sources.relevance: Directly confirms Moore’s appointment after Wood’s resignation and BCG’s withdrawal.
